translated_title: Commissions Approve Impeachment Trial Against Samuel García; NL Congress Gives Him 15 Days to Make a Statement
original_title: Aprueban en comisiones juicio político contra Samuel García; Congreso de NL le da 15 días para declarar
author: Vianney Carrera
meta_description: The Nuevo León Congress Anti-Corruption Commission approved an impeachment trial against Governor Samuel García over alleged triangulation of nearly one billion pesos.
